# Kindling α3.13c: Keep the fire, change the food

## What is new

A finite hearth burns wood into ash, leaves embers, and can be fed, blown, banked or carried through ordinary choices. Dry drilling and grinding can produce an ember through normal chance; wet wood cannot. People remember warmth they actually felt. Fire changes comfort, water use, task light and food: one hour can cook roots or meat; prolonged or hotter exposure burns it. Moving a portion pauses its saved exposure.

## What to try

Check build 41303: [APK](../build/apk-check/kindling-41303-check.apk), 29,249,259 bytes (27.894 MiB). Start a new Discovery camp, inspect fuel, follow someone tending or resting by fire, and compare warmth near and away. Inspect cooked food and a separate burnt portion; save while its timer is running and reopen. “New camp · fire already out” starts with the same finite stock and five starting crafts, without invented warmth or fire-making knowledge. The labelled First flake example is recaptured from ordinary seed 43 within the unchanged three-day limit.

Not release-signed: built in check mode; release signing waits for the owner's passphrase.
The earlier release in dist/kindling.apk stays intact; the throwaway key cannot update its installation.

## What is rough

Touched checks pass: 142 simulation cases / 29,899 assertions (22.82 s), then 45 focused fire/learning cases / 116,069 assertions after the cooking demonstration repair; three immutable-view cases / 1,389 assertions (11.15 s), then 1,564 assertions (9.80 s) with explicit optional checks; 27 app cases (17.28 s) after repairing overlapping fire/person taps. Final fire regressions: 19 cases / 115,341 assertions (1.43 s). Low/high calibration retains 200 independent trials for each recipe, including both friction routes, banking/carrying, roots and meat. Five changed native lint files pass (175.37 s). APK build and verification: 117.57 s. The first routine failed in 390.62 s on native lint and eight assertions in the person-picking case; those findings are repaired. The second routine failed in 213.74 s on a fire-reader expression with two storage-view calls; native/view tests, ten matching proof suites, 83 app cases and 165 tool cases passed. The expression is sequenced now. Reader regressions (3 cases / 63 assertions, 0.32 s), its native lint (41.79 s), complete simulation/view source rules, and the remaining full view lint (31 files, 96.52 s), document and ID checks pass separately. Both routine attempts remain failed records; no third full routine ran. The final-source APK rebuild verified in 70.87 s.. Integrated self-review ran once, approximately four minutes (00:07–00:11 UTC). Storage is format 4; earlier camps are refused with the plain older-build message. Immutable display sampling matches exact body/thermal state and does not advance the camp. Actual fire task light now supplies the already-decided darkness exception for work and watching. The grounded hearth remains inspectable beneath resting people. Extra flame poses were cut; roots and meat remain.

The fireless α3.13b spread gate remains failed at 4/40 against 32 required. Those forty are retained and never rejudged; the repaired input selection awaits α3.13e's fresh closing gate. This mild camp does not prove winter survival, full starting populations, poison health effects or parallel craft speed. The illustrated capture is not a frequency pass. Phone frame timing, sustained speed, heat/battery, phone/cloud comparison and owner play answers remain unmeasured. Release signing still needs KINDLING_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE. Original pinned SDK/NDK URLs returned 404; the checksum-matching Google mirrors supplied the same pinned files.
